result.topic_en: Draft of hypotheses explaining the laws of falling bodies and planetary motion: since Newton, besides geometric axioms, a law of inertia, changes of motion caused by forces composed by the parallelogram rule, and a force directed toward every ponderable point that varies inversely with the square of the distance (with attempts to explain it through processes in space).

items.english: This law of inertia cannot be explained from the concept of the ponderable point by sufficient reasons. That the body continues its motion must have a cause, which can only be sought in its internal state.

items.english: Every deviation from rectilinear uniform motion is the consequence of a change of its (internal) state, for which a cause must be sought.
